remaining_limits: Caller-provided reviewer identities do not prove cognition independence; parent must use separate blinded assistant contexts.
Assistant judgments are not human validation.
Mapping verification on an initial unreviewed analysis intentionally leaves analysis_semantic_reviews_verified false; verify again against the final reviewed analysis to bind its actual scores.
SHA256/read-only files are integrity evidence, not privileged WORM storage.
This audit did not inspect actual collected outputs, reviewer decisions, or final arithmetic.
scope: Source and synthetic structural review of blinded-review comparison, adjudication resolution and post-freeze mapping verification. No semantic judgments assigned.
verified_properties: Input packets require opaque unique IDs, exactly approved packet fields, no explicit evidence/request IDs, no undelivered raw answer, and no authorized truth background for denied cases.
Both independent sheets must cover exactly the full packet with valid common labels and five boolean flags.
Agreement compares label plus all five flags and intentionally ignores rationale-only differences; no semantic labels are generated by the program.
Both original sheets and the packet/instructions are retained as byte-identical copies; resolved agreements retain the first exact judgment object including rationale.
Every disagreement requires exactly one valid third-review judgment; proposals are randomized and unlabeled, with model/condition/timing/mapping absent.
Normalized distinct reviewer and adjudicator labels are enforced; actual independent cognition remains workflow provenance.
Resolution recomputes all comparison counts and ID sets against frozen originals before use.
Compare and resolve do not access private mappings; judgment resolution is sealed before the separate verify-mapping phase opens the sealed analysis.
Mapping verification requires complete unique group coverage, exact observation-key/case/group agreement with attempts.csv, and observed-attempt counts; planned coverage is a separate explicit field.
When supplied a reviewed analysis, mapping verification also requires the exact frozen judgments and original resolved-source digest, preventing same-ID different-grade attachment.
Seals bind the exact file set and bytes, source copies and reproduction commands are retained, and new directories avoid replacing earlier artifacts.
